race.title: Coral 'Black Friday Price Boosts' 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
race.verdict: PRINCE RUPERT looked something out of the ordinary when making a winning bumper debut at Kempton back in March, a race Nicky Henderson landed with Shishkin a few years earlier. He's an exciting prospect now hurdling with his yard boasting a fine record in this race. Unsurprisingly there is depth in opposition, with dangers headed up by fellow impressive bumper winner River Kwai . Ffos Las second Oatsoeasy and Lover Desbois complete the shortlist. PRINCE RUPERT RIVER KWAI (FR) OATSOEASY (IRE)
